rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person or thing is unsuitable for a team, situation, or purpose.

example.english: This job is unfit for you.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 m4 sik1 hap6 nei5

rows.note: Use this when unfit means lacking the official qualifications or requirements, rather than simply being unsuitable.

example.english: They are unfit to join this program.
example.traditional: 佢唔合資格參加呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: keoi5 m4 hap6 zi1 gaak3 caam1 gaa1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who is physically out of shape or has poor fitness.

example.english: They exercise little and are physically unfit.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ping4 si4 siu2 wan6 dung6 tai2 nang4 caa1
